about: What torii calls 'common' in `torii approve`. Common means usual for FiveM resources, not guaranteed safe. Never a whole host or a whole account: GitHub's API also accepts issues and comments, so a prefix such as api.github.com/repos/<owner> is a way out for data. Only exact read-only endpoints qualify. Every addition needs a reason and a source, by pull request.
